file_roles.evidence: getProperty, setProperty and getModifiers read the fields directly; the fix makes each call the accessor first, 'MetaMethod getter = getGetter();' and 'MetaMethod setter = getSetter();'. Because the subclass holds its own getter and setter, reading the parent's fields saw null, which produced the reported 'Cannot set read-only property: id' thrown two lines below.

rationale: Both messages quoted in the report, 'Cannot set read-only property: ' and 'Cannot read write-only property: ', appear verbatim in the changed file, so the throw site and the defect are the same lines. The reporter blamed a different class, asking 'Is there any reason why ThreadManagedMetaBeanProperty stores these values locally?', but the fix lands in the parent, MetaBeanProperty, which should have gone through its own accessors.
notes: Useful example of the report naming the wrong class. A localizer that follows the reporter's diagnosis to ThreadManagedMetaBeanProperty is led away from the gold file.
